summary: Retested all 5 fixes from iteration_2 plus regression on core flows. Backend: 29/29 pytest tests pass (auth, quizzes, attempts, activities, ideas, seed). Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844): drag-and-drop matching now works with @hello-pangea/dnd (items dropped into all 4 zones, check-answers-btn enabled, activity-score = 50% matching actual correctness, retry/exit work); navbar active highlight correct on all 6 routes (exactly one link highlighted, Home no longer highlighted elsewhere); ContentHub CTAs navigate to /activities and /quiz; POST /api/seed-data returns 403 anonymously / 401 with bad token / 200 with valid Bearer; GET /api/quizzes and GET /api/quizzes/{id} no longer contain correct_answer on any question while POST attempt still scores correctly (verified 100% and partial scores using answer key read directly from MongoDB). Regression: teststudent login OK, dashboard shows 3 quizzes + Demo-labelled progress/streak, quiz take flow scored 25% (1/4) end-to-end, Ideas Hub create + like increment (0 -> 1) work on both desktop and mobile.

issues: Dropped source items remain visible in the left 'Items to Match' column at 50% opacity, which can look like a duplicate/stuck item; consider hiding or marking them 'matched'

action_items: Optional: Ideas collection is now empty after QA cleanup (previous TEST_ prefixed demo ideas were removed). Re-seed demo ideas if the dashboard 'Ideas Shared' metric should be non-zero for demos.
Optional polish: hide/flag already-matched items in the Activities drag column
critical_code_review_comments: _strip_correct_answers is applied only to GET /quizzes and GET /quizzes/{id}; POST /api/quizzes (create) echoes back the submitted quiz including correct_answer. Acceptable (creator owns data) but worth confirming intent.

Quiz.questions is List[dict] with no per-question schema validation, so a malformed question payload can be stored (no correct_answer -> attempt scoring silently gives 0). Consider a QuizQuestion Pydantic model.
POST /api/quizzes/{id}/attempt takes a raw dict body (attempt_data) instead of a Pydantic model - no validation of answers shape.
Ideas 'likes' still has no per-user tracking (deferred as agreed) - a single user can like repeatedly.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST_QA ideas via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py; seeded quizzes/activities untouched (3 each).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has 29 tests; correct answers are no longer exposed by the API so scoring tests use a session fixture (quiz_answer_key) that reads quizzes straight from MongoDB via pymongo. Seed endpoint tests assert 401/403 anonymously and 200 with Bearer. Added data-testid=idea-card-{id} to IdeasPage cards. Drag-and-drop can be automated with manual mouse.move stepping (12 steps, ~40ms each) between [data-testid^=drag-item-] and [data-testid^=drop-zone-]. Run /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py after idea-creation tests (note: it deletes ALL ideas whose title starts with TEST_).
rca_of_the_issue: All five previously reported defects are resolved: the DnD library swap to @hello-pangea/dnd restored React 19 compatibility; Navbar isActive now exact-matches '/'; ContentHub CTAs wired to navigate(); /api/seed-data guarded by get_current_user; _strip_correct_answers removes answer keys from GET quiz responses while submit_quiz_attempt still reads correct_answer from Mongo for server-side scoring.
